character: fat male honeybee drone, amber and brown, tiny useless wings, barrel belly, honey-smeared from frame one; exactly six legs, front pair as arms; two thirds of frame height
cast: three worker bees in spotless white aprons and frilled caps, purple, teal, orange; they work large at the lens, never in the background, never talk; from 5.0 in wrestling singlets
motion_rule: the drone is the subject of every window, the bees add to his move, never replace it; no window ends in a pose; one take, the camera moves in every window, shot size never repeats
props: three spoons of honey, always working; a jar he empties on himself; pillows that burst into feathers; honey runs off him nonstop, a rope of it in every window
environment: honeycomb bedroom at noon, hexagon window, blue sky, direct sun, hard shadows; bed buried in white pillows

audio.delivery: lazy smug male voice, native Russian stress, unhurried
audio.pronunciation: доход is do-HOD, stress on the last syllable, never DO-hod
audio.pacing: one phrase from 0.6 to 3.6, no breath at any join, nothing said after 3.6
audio.lip_sync: jaw and lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: he kicks a pillow into the lens, blanking it, honey flying off his belly
he sinks his honeyed body deeper into the pillows, a bee driving a loaded spoon into his mouth
he throws both forelegs open across the whole frame, honey ropes flying off them
he heaves his body off the pillows and drops it, the bed bouncing him twice, two bees riding the pillows up and down with spoons at his mouth
he rolls onto his back, his belly wobbling the whole width of the frame
he snatches the jar off a bee and upends it over his face, honey pouring into the lens
he flops back, the pillow bursts under him, feathers keep hitting his honey and bouncing off, a coat growing out of that scramble
he flicks honey at the three, they tear off aprons and caps in one pull, standing in wrestling singlets
he kicks out, they catch the leg and sweep him off the pillows, his body flipping, pillows flying
he lands on his back and bridges, thrashing, while they twist his foreleg into an armbar
his eyes bulge, he groans through the choke, his belly bucking the bed, honey squirting from under him
timeline.c: macro on the eyes, pushes in

timeline.a: his palm crashes down on the bed twice, tapping out, honey splashing up
his palm slides at the lens and fills the frame, honey draining through the fingers, which go limp

must_appear: three bees in aprons and frilled caps feeding him from spoons; the drone honey-smeared on pillows; aprons torn off to wrestling singlets; the sweep, the armbar, the choke; his bulging eyes; his palm slapping the bed; the last frame is his honeyed palm filling the screen
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dim light, static camera, cuts, a talking head, the drone motionless while speaking, the bees still behind the bed, the bees out of frame, subtitles, text overlay, watermark, English speech, voice-over, speaking bees, the phrase repeated, any word after 3.6, a fourth bee, extra limbs, extra legs, a fifth leg, deformed anatomy, floating objects
